Xi Jinping had been stressed out for as long as he could remember. It only got worse when he became president. One wrong move, and China could face major problems.

Sitting back into his chair, he sighed and stared into the distance, contemplating the current situation. Deep in the recesses of his mind, he knew of one method to help alleviate the current situation temporarily.

A few months back, several government officials bought Xi Jinping the new strand of weed, SeaWeed. When they were given to Xi, they were wrapped, ready for use. Currently, they were being kept in the back of his desk, in case he ever was to use it.

"No, I can't..." he thought to himself. "China is strictly against cannabis."

Yet a voice responded, "No one will know about it..."

"But still, if the President of China was caught smoking, there would be hell to pay."

"Your home is securely guarded, nothing leaves or enters without you or someone else knowing."

"They could walk in here and see me."

"Look at the time. There's no way at this time of day someone would barge in here unannounced."

"But the principle of the matter..."

"Relax, it's only one time. It'll help you get over your stress problems you're currently facing."

"Well, I guess if it's only once, and that's it..."

"That's the spirit!"

Xi Jinping lit the wrapped cannabis, and inhaled the psychoactive drug. Slowly, all his worries fell away, and in their stead was hunger. Rising from his chair, he walked over to the door to grab something from the kitchen. Yet as he was doing that, he felt a weird sensation, almost as if parts of him were detached from this world.

"This must just be a side affect of the strength of this drug." He assured himself.

As he opened the door, he saw a face. Immediately he closed the door out of shock. Had they heard what he was conversing? No, they couldn't have, as no one else was in the room, and the talking was just happening in his head.

Checking a second time, he slowly opened the door, to see that there was actually never a face there. Was he dreaming it was there, or was this yet again a side affect? Ignoring that, Xi Jinping headed off towards the kitchen to grab a bite to satiate his hunger.
